Bihar MLC Election Results 2026 Live Vote Counting: bihar vidhan parishad ki aath nirvachan siton (char snatak aur char shikshak kote) ke lie aaj matganna jari hai. panch pramukh shahron- patna, mujaphpharpur, darbhanga, purniya aur chhapra men banae gae kendron par subah aath baje se maton ki ginti shuru huee. idhar saran, darbhanga aur patna men matganna ke dauran hangama hone ki khabar hai. idhar darbhanga shikshak nirvachan kshetr men jan suraj ke suresh ray ki jit men pech phans gaya hai.
